sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE d.disease_type != '' GROUP BY type_family
